Delta requirements for the `feature-extend` arrowhead size capability have been written to `.sdlc/runs/20261105-152345-feature-extend-arrowhead-size/requirements.md`.

### Summary of Deliverables
- **In scope (1–6) & Out of scope (1–7):** Captured the approved scope from `intent_brief.md` and all explicit Non-goals.
- **Functional Requirements (`FR-1`–`FR-10`):** Organized per module (`@excalidraw/common`, `@excalidraw/element`, `@excalidraw/excalidraw`, and Tests & Documentation), covering the optional element property, default-key omission, geometry/bounds/short-segment fitting, downstream consumers (`elbowArrow.ts`, `transform.ts`, `renderElement.ts`), restore validation, properties-panel action, and `currentItem*` app-state propagation across `App.tsx`, `App.drawshape.ts`, `flowchart.ts`, `convertToShape.ts`, and `ConvertElementTypePopup.tsx`.
- **Non-Functional Requirements (`NFR-1`–`NFR-6`):** Enforced the ban on `yarn test:update`, restricted snapshot updates to the three allowed app-state snapshot files (`history.test.tsx.snap`, `regressionTests.test.tsx.snap`, `contextmenu.test.tsx.snap`), mandated the two `AGENTS.md` coding rules, prohibited `.gitignore` modifications, and deferred property name and value type selection to the architect.
- **PII Inventory & Role Matrix:** Documented as `None` and `Not applicable`.
- **Acceptance Criteria (`AC-1`–`AC-6`) & Open Questions:** Defined executable test and verification criteria including the exact test gate `yarn test:typecheck && yarn test:code && yarn test:app --watch=false`.
